subject.title: Feature: configurable mediaLocalRoots for image tool

question: What local filesystem root policy should OpenClaw expose for image/media tools that need host paths outside the default workspace and media roots?
rationale: The request would expand model-facing local file read authority, and the safe shape depends on maintainer intent for `workspaceOnly`, channel inbound roots, and the broader `tools.fs.roots` proposal.

options.title: Adopt one central root policy
options.body: Use a single reviewed filesystem/media-root policy such as the `tools.fs.roots` direction, with schema/docs/tests covering image tools, outbound media, and `workspaceOnly` interactions.

options.title: Add narrow media-only roots
options.body: Expose a smaller `tools.media` or image/media-understanding root allowlist, accepting a separate trust boundary from general filesystem roots.

options.title: Keep copy-or-managed-media behavior
options.body: Decline configurable host roots for now and keep users moving media into OpenClaw-managed/workspace paths or channel-scoped inbound roots.

recommendation.title: Adopt one central root policy
recommendation.body: Use a single reviewed filesystem/media-root policy such as the `tools.fs.roots` direction, with schema/docs/tests covering image tools, outbound media, and `workspaceOnly` interactions.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored a prior overlapping MEMBER PR and are a plausible maintainer-side owner for deciding whether to revive, replace, or reject the broader local-root policy.
